column2: Load the settings image, or defaults on a new/invalid EEPROM
Power-off loop: only the DISPLAY link and CAT (PS1) run
Defaults were loaded: write the RAM image to EEPROM
Radio on: drive the port outputs for the on state
SDR FPGA handshake on SCI5
DSP handshake on SCI4 ("i DB00", read reg 0/1)
Never returns: the 16-task round-robin loop
Task 2: TX/RX and power supervisor
Task 3: push changed radio state to the SDR FPGA
Task 4: DSP register writes and status reads
Task 5: shift registers and DACs on P6/P7/PA/PB
Task 7: one CAT command per pass
Task 8: FH-2 remote keypad on the resistor ladder
Task 13: SD CARD menu load/save steps
Task 14: DISPLAY link receive, ACK/NAK, next frame
Task 15: key events through the key handler tables
Ring empty: only an E9 frame from the E9 slot is handled
Take the oldest command from the 60-slot CAT ring
Port still sending: put the command back for the next pass
Upper-case the two mnemonic characters only
Look the mnemonic up in cat_mnemonics (104 entries)
Radio off: only index 0x47 = PS with '1' passes
Not primary: look it up in cat_ext_mnemonics (10 entries)
Unknown mnemonic: answer ?;
Primary: switch on the index, with a length check
Send the reply built at 0x1C8E on the request's port
Auto-information: report changed items to ports with AI on
AF mute follows PB3 while in RX (state 8)
GPIO poll and TX state machine on trx_state
Supply ADC below 0x7DD: power off and save
Power key: save the operating state to EEPROM
Software reset; the CPU restarts in the power-off loop
Screen-saver timer: ask the DISPLAY to toggle it
The arbiter picks a PTT source and may start TX or release
State 0: TX frequency allowed? then state 1 and its timers
RX->TX timers 0x0C..0x11 (1,1,5,1,3 ms, TX delay)
Clear the SDR and DSP acknowledgements of the switch
Timer 0x0C: DATA_BUSY (P24) on
Timer 0x0D: AF mute on
Timer 0x0E: speakers off (P70/PB2/P80), not in CW
Both links acknowledged: speakers back, unmute, state 2
Timer 0x0F: RX line PB7 off (RX8 rail)
Timer 0x10: TX line P73 on (TX8 rail)
TX delay over: state 3, SEND_A/SEND_B may key
Release: state 5, SEND off
TX->RX timers from d = 2 x CW WAVE SHAPE + 4 ms
Audio comes back last: d + the SDR filter delay 0x20B4A
State 7: switching back to RX
Timer 0x10: TX line P73 off
Timer 0x0F: RX line PB7 on
Timer 0x0C: DATA_BUSY off
Back in RX (state 8)
First active PTT source in priority order (CAT TX1 first)
TX refused: TXINH (PA1) = 1, end TX if it was on
TX allowed: TXINH follows ETUN_TXINH_REQ (P14)
PTT seen on 2 passes: start TX (state 0) and the TOT
TX time-out expired: inhibit TX until PTT release
TOT pre-warning: beep pattern 7
VOX released: hang time from ROM 0xFFF8833C
CW-type modes: break-in delay timer 0x1A
PTT off after the hang: release (state 4)
TX inhibit: cfg105[3] or TX INHIBIT (EX030407)
CAT disabled from the DISPLAY link: no TX
TX time-out tripped: no TX
Walk the destination's {lo, hi} TX ranges
Tuning or 0x20B9E: clear every PTT request
Any PTT source restarts the screen-saver timer
DAKY/RTS/DTR or 8/9 in a CW mode: the line keys CW
Any source but VOX: hold VOX off for 200 ms
Write pending: wait for the FPGA's ACK
CAT/DISPLAY asked for the SDR update bridge
TX/RX change: wait until the old switching line drops
Change detectors: the first one that sends ends the pass
RX-only registers, skipped while transmitting
First full sync: reg 0x15 = 0x2000, reg 0x24 = 0x0317
SDR settled for the TX sequencer (state 1 or 7)
Write in flight: ACK 0x06 confirms the shadow value
Read in flight: valid r-reply goes to the shadow
ISP tunnel for a DSP firmware update
RX/TX steady: read status regs 1..4, one per pass
After reg 4: next status burst in 20 ms
Setter chain: the first register that changed is sent
A complete frame from the DISPLAY?
Bad checksum: answer NAK
Dispatch by the frame's type byte
Retry timer 0x3B for the frame just sent
Send the next queued frame
0xF1: SDR bridge, DSP ISP tunnel or CAT disable
0xE0: key or touch event
0xE1: encoder step
0xE2: SD-card state
0xE3: date/time from the DISPLAY RTC
0xE4: the DISPLAY woke up, screen saver off
0xE6: beep request
0xE7: PlayList recorder/player status
0xF0: hello with version, date and boot code
0xC3: answer to an SD CARD command (0x43)
b1, b2: DISPLAY version string "Vxx-yy"
b4..b6: DISPLAY date "yy-mm-dd"
b7: boot code (key held at the DISPLAY's power-on)
Power on: link up, hello reply pending
Boot code 1: full reset of the settings
Boot code 2: factory alignment mode
Boot code 4: numeric-entry/adjust mode
TTBF unlock off: TX BPF SEL above 4 back to 1
Boot code 6: DISPLAY in its loader screen, link down
Boot code 7: swap the region (destination code)
1: 0x60 hello reply with the four versions
3: 0x24 display settings
4: 0x7F power command, EEPROM save, reset
6: 0x7C, blocks until E5
7: 0x7B screen saver on/off
9: 0x70 dialog box
10: 0x43/0x44/0x45 SD CARD requests
14: 0x65 clock for the DISPLAY RTC
21: 0x40 menu page, at most every 100 units
22: 0x37 FUNC panel
24: 0x20 status block, sent only when changed
0x7F frame: power command, then the 8-byte key
Low-voltage off (0x90): wait 2000 units instead of saving
Software reset
Read the 10-byte header; byte 0x4658 says what is valid
Valid image: read everything
State 0: keep cfg105 and the destination, defaults for the rest
Blank EEPROM: clear the header, full defaults
Auto-repeat on timer 0x40
